back_side:
**fine; OK**

_كل شيء تمام._
tamām · Kull shayʾ tamām · Everything is fine

**thank you**

_شكراً على المساعدة._
shukran · Shukran ʿalā l-musāʿada · Thanks for the help
notes: more emphatic: شكراً جزيلاً shukran jazīlan

back_side:
**the door**

_الباب مفتوح._
bāb · Al-bāb maftūḥ · The door is open

**three**

_عندي ثلاثة كتب._
thalātha · ʿIndī thalāthat kutub · I have three books
notes: form used when counting masculine nouns

back_side:
**much; many**

_عندنا وقت كثير._
kathīr · ʿIndanā waqt kathīr · We have a lot of time

**the camel**

_الجمل يشرب الماء._
jamal · Al-jamal yashrab al-māʾ · The camel is drinking water

**the mountain**

_نسكن قرب الجبل._
jabal · Naskun qurb al-jabal · We live near the mountain

**the man**

_الرجل يقرأ جريدة._
rajul · Ar-rajul yaqraʾ jarīda · The man is reading a newspaper

**lord; head (of a household)**

_هو رب الأسرة._
rabb · Huwa rabb al-usra · He is the head of the household

**the flower**

_هذه زهرة جميلة._
zahra · Hādhihi zahra jamīla · This is a beautiful flower

**oil (edible)**

_زيت الزيتون لذيذ._
zayt · Zayt az-zaytūn ladhīdh · Olive oil is delicious

**the company**

_أعمل في شركة كبيرة._
sharika · Aʿmal fī sharika kabīra · I work at a big company

**in**

_الكتاب في الحقيبة._
fī · Al-kitāb fī l-ḥaqība · The book is in the bag

**the team**

_فريقنا فاز اليوم._
farīq · Farīqunā fāza l-yawm · Our team won today

**lemon**

_أحب عصير الليمون._
laymūn · Uḥibb ʿaṣīr al-laymūn · I like lemon juice

**night**

_أدرس في الليل._
layl · Adrus fī l-layl · I study at night

**Layla (girl's name)**

_اسمها ليلى._
Laylā · Ismuhā Laylā · Her name is Layla

**banana**

_أشتري الموز من السوق._
mawz · Ashtarī l-mawz min as-sūq · I buy bananas at the market

**sunset; the Maghreb**

_المغرب بلد جميل._
maghrib · Al-Maghrib balad jamīl · Morocco is a beautiful country
notes: المغرب al-Maghrib = Morocco; also the sunset prayer
